status: Successful bounded public CustomXamlResourceLoader feasibility control; not a whole-application migration or complete native-memory fix.

measurementProvenance.sourceArchive: Eight archived diagnostic/source files plus the exact successful controller are fingerprinted below. They include the default ResourceLoader path normalization; the previously rejected LocalizedStringExtension class remains compiled but is not used by this fixture.
measurementProvenance.timestampScope: Raw reports contain no run timestamp. evidenceDate labels the investigation date.
measurementProvenance.deliveryState: Temporary routes and fixture sources were removed after measurement. No whole-application CustomResource migration had been measured.

protocol.isolation: Three fresh processes on private test desktops, disconnected from product services/hardware. The same preview build runs baseline, candidate and candidate-default.
protocol.commonSetup: One persistent offscreen Window; a shared CustomXamlResourceLoader is registered once in every mode. One public MRM child lookup supplies the known subtree vtable for classification.
protocol.workload: Three warmup template creations followed by 200 measured creations. Each cycle adds the template content, drains the dispatcher, reads values, tracks weak fixture/content references, then clears the host and drains again.
protocol.retirement: Dispatcher drain, forced full GC, finalizer wait, another full GC and dispatcher drain precede each census; final idle also waits three seconds. 406 weak references cover the 203 fixture/content pairs, excluding the subsequent translation checks.
protocol.baseline: Two x:Uid controls localize four properties.
protocol.candidate: The same four properties use CustomResource and the shared public loader, which delegates to LocalizedResources.Get. An extra TextBlock exercises a missing-resource punctuation fallback.
protocol.defaultPath: candidate-default measures ru-RU with no explicit LocalizedResources override; the default ResourceLoader now receives ToResourceMapPath(key).
protocol.fairnessLimit: The candidate performs an additional fallback lookup and creates an extra TextBlock; total heap bytes are not an equal-work performance comparison.

census.scope: Locked default-process HeapWalk; busy allocations whose first pointer lies within one of five selected module images. A leading-pointer bucket is not necessarily a C++ vtable or an independently reachable object.

baseline.resourceContext: explicit en-US override; cached ResourceMap path

candidate.resourceContext: explicit en-US override; cached ResourceMap path

functionalValidation.oracle: Four resource properties compared exactly with UTF-8-decoded canonical Resources.resw values; independently repeated from the saved reports.
functionalValidation.checksOccurAfterCensus: The five language/restore checks follow native collection and do not affect reported allocation slopes.

findings.resourceMap: Baseline adds two 104-byte subtrees per measured template: 400 allocations and 41,600 payload bytes over 200 cycles. Both candidate paths stay at three subtrees across all checkpoints. Child allocations and allocator overhead are excluded from this byte count.
findings.replacementLeakCheck: No MarkupExtension-wrapper headers occur in any successful mode. Across all 894 buckets, no new fixture-proportional family persists into idle in either candidate. UI.Input and Windowing aggregate counts remain 161 and 28 respectively in every snapshot.

remainingSharedPool.interpretation: Small shared baseline/candidate growth remains; these snapshots do not establish an eventual bound or retaining reference. It does not reproduce the rejected five-per-fixture slope.

findings.transientLimit: The English candidate retains 5,709 XAML leading-pointer blocks at idle versus 1,930 baseline and 1,929 default. Counts fluctuate and fall sharply from batch 200; zero managed fixture/root references does not establish complete native reclamation.
findings.classifierLimit: The apparent small linear XAML bucket at RVA 0xA20038 resolves to GUID_4e897caa_59d5_4613_8f8c_f7ebd1f399b0, not a vtable; its candidate count falls from nine to two at idle.
findings.unmeasured: This fixture records no typed handle census or total process private-byte metric and does not resolve the Intel graphics allocation lead or prove every app path safe.

excludedAlternatives.decision: Rejected: both explicit/default prototypes accumulate 120-byte native wrappers at five per fixture, counts 15/265/515/1015/1015, or 120,000 additional payload bytes over 200 measured cycles, despite dead fixture/root weak references.
excludedAlternatives.symbolResolution: RVA 0xBAAC70 was resolved exactly using cached matching Microsoft.UI.Xaml symbols in a pre-existing offline dump; this does not identify the retaining reference.

excludedAlternatives.decision: Rejected after the null-DataContext template failed its required fallback assertion. The incomplete run is not successful localization or leak validation; no dummy DataContext was introduced.

The app produced valid translated values, but Windows PowerShell read no-BOM UTF-8 resource oracles using its default encoding and rejected them. The corrected controller explicitly decodes UTF-8; all recorded binary hashes are identical between attempts. Only the corrected complete three-mode run supplies the comparison above.

review: Independent Codex evidence check. Claude review remains incomplete after the previously requested run exhausted its quota without findings.
privacy: Raw dumps, object addresses, module bases, process IDs, handles and private local paths remain excluded; only module RVAs, public resource identifiers and basename fingerprints are included.
